name: Deep Memorial Public School
description: About Us DMPS – A Day-Cum Residential, Senior Secondary School, Affiliated to CBSE, New Delhi Deep Memorial Public School (DMPS) offers a unique opportunity to educate your child in an institution that has built a legacy of academic excellence in the last three decades of its existence. The facilities for extra-curricular activities provide plenty of room for opportunity for students to engage in sports and arts where our activity rooms are fully equipped with the latest interactive and innovative technology. Our effort is to provide each child with an enabling environment that helps to hone their innate talent and acquire new skills. We welcome the prospective parents to visit DMPS and witness for themselves the investment DMPS makes in their child’s development. Vision and Mission: A shared vision is not an idea, it is rather a force in people’s heart- at its simplest level, a shared vision is the answer to the question ‘What do we want to create?’ At DMPS we have resolved to empower, challenge and motivate students, teachers, staff, parents, school leaders and community members to learn, achieve and excel. It is a place where not only traditional lines of thought are respected but the teachers keep abreast of innovative pedagogies that enliven the teaching. As a result, our academic curriculum is periodically reviewed to make learning more dynamic and progressive using the best practices. DMPS truly believes that “strength is gained with our hands but zeal is only acquired through our minds.” By moulding young minds into skilled, responsible individuals we hope they will make a difference to the globalised world in which they will pursue their respective future careers. Our value based approach aims to instill good morals, ethics as well as a sense of responsibility for holistic development of the children. The students at DMPS are encouraged to become independent, open-minded, well groomed individuals who embrace the life-long learnings that are imparted in the school. At the same time emphasis is also laid on creating model citizens that uphold their fundamental duties and contribute to the national's interest. Therefore, we at DMPS strive to nurture students into good human beings that are guided in this journey by a community of competent and caring educators who boast of rich experience. To meet these aims a congenial environment is provided not only physically but also mentally, emotionally, morally and aesthetically. Pupils are provided with unlimited opportunities to pursue their interests, be it academics, co-curricular activities or sports and achieve excellence in all these spheres.

name: Sharda World School
description: About Us In ancient times when Gurukul was the epicentre of learning, Acharyas used to mould students by highlighting the importance of the five elements of nature. Sharda World School is going back to our golden heritage to build the foundation of child and equip them with 21st century skills. Aligned with the National Education Policy 2020, the school implements a gold mine of relevant and meaningful models of learning that guarantee Holistic Development of the child. Part of the 90-acre Sharda Knowledge Park, Sharda World School will raise the bar excellence in holistic education in India. Sharda World School is a part of Sharda Corporation, India’s leading education and healthcare group established in 1996 with a vision to think beyond. A journey that started with establishing North India’s first engineering colleges in Anand & Mathura took a bigger shape with the setting up of Sharda University campuses in Greater Noida and Andijan, Uzbekistan. Sharda World School is proud of the fact that in just over two years of establishment, it has achieved a unique landmark of winning ‘Emerging school in India’ award from Business World magazine, Best Private School for Educational Excellence- State-wise by SA Indian School Awards, 2023 and the highly prestigious International School Awards for Experiential Learning. Vision Our vision is to raise exemplary students and leaders who can inspire and innovate to help grow their communities. Mission Our mission is to foster honest, collaborative, and empathetic leaders that excel and realize their potential. We aim to provide a safe, secure, holistic, and nurturing Space that inspires students to become independent, capable and global citizens. Our learning philosophy Our learning philosophy is based on the principle of Panchamahabhutas or the 5 elements of nature – Water, Earth, Air, Fire, and Space. The Human body is also made of these 5 elements in different proportions – 72% Water, 12% Earth, 6% Air, 4% Fire, and the rest is Space. Our pedagogy is designed in such a manner that apart from gathering knowledge, our students are able to harmonize themselves with these elements. When children enter the folds of SWS, they are received by the element of Water, and as they get nurtured and groomed through the Foundation, Preparatory, Middle, and High School years, they pass through the elements of Earth, Air, Space, and Fire through abundant opportunities to explore new concepts, analyze the relationships between different subjects/topics/questions, connect the dots, learn problem-solving, design solutions and build critical thinking, predict the outcomes and take action of executing and implementing innovative ideas. The teaching pedagogy is based on peer-to-peer learning rather than creating a competitive environment in the classroom. The whole objective is to create a collaborative learning space where the child is made curious to ask questions and learn from the teacher and their fellow classmates.

The well researched, project based international learning methodology of the school is designed to prepare students to excel in the world’s finest school. The Vishnu Bhagwan Public School aims to provide a learning environment where students are challenged to reach their individual potential by the acquisition of knowledge and the development of personal, cultural and democratic values essential for future success. Vishnu Bhagwan Public School believes that class room learning is not sufficient to make a child excel in life; therefore it aims to provide students with learning beyond academics, by developing talents through an emphasis on extracurricular activities and life skills. The teachers are the heart of the academic program and Vishnu Bhagwan Public School is committed to have motivated and trained teachers. The school also aims to emphasize the importance of collaboration between parents and the school so that all parents are actively involved in their children’s education.

name: R. S. Convent Sainik School
description: About Us R. S. Convent Sainik School the prestigious institution affiliated to C.B.S.E. was a dream realisation of 'Ranju Singh Educational Society' led by Sri Sudama Singh, a retired army person. The serene and green atmosphere of Ledhupur a nondescript village a few kilometers from the city of Varanasi and adjacent to the international Buddha pilgrimage centre Sarnath, provided the right setting for the strategy of this modern day 'Gurukul'. The official inauguration of the school took place on 04/04/2004. The school's begining was humble but high were it's aspiration. It was set up with the aim of providing an integrated and all-round education. The need of a boarding house to cater for the academic excellence and character formation of children was felt and in 2007 R. S. Convent Sainik School’s Hostel for Boys came into existence. A Hostel for girls also came into being attached in February 2010. R. S. Convent has developed into full fledged institution as one of the leading Senior Secondary Schools over the years. The progress achieved is highly admirable. It has always aimed at an integral development of the students and this is what sets the school apart from others.

description: About Us DPS has been functioning under the aegis of the Delhi Public School Society, New Delhi. At present, the society has around 200 schools in India and abroad. The group with the country's best interest at heart is dedicated to improving the education level of the nation. The promoters of educational institutions run over fifteen schools in different parts of Uttar Pradesh.

description: About Us Genesis Global School is situated in Noida, a suburb of Delhi, and is part of the National Capital Region (Delhi NCR). The School, ranked one of the best schools in Noida, is spread across a world – class 30 acre campus with super connectivity via a 6-lane expressway. Whether day scholars or in the boarding school GGS students are confident, disciplined and critical thinkers. These qualities ensure that they grow into responsible and caring adults of a global society. We encourage experiential learning and create opportunities for growth. Living hence in one of the best boarding schools in India helps students develop healthy self-respect and increased problem-solving abilities as well. Keeping this in mind, the curriculum is designed to go beyond academics as well. While academic achievement is valued and supported; Our curriculum seeks to balance physical, emotional, social and spiritual growth with academics. We develop in our student’s optimism, confidence, enthusiasm, concern for justice and an idealism which will metamorphose into growth, and a global perspective that they should carry as young adults. The green campus concept has been employed in planning and construction of the campus. The highlights of the approach include the use of fly ash in the building material, solar heating, water harvesting, recycling of waste, effluent treatment, plastic free and chemical free landscaping.
